## runtime delete

Delete a runner

Deletes a revoked runner; its past runs keep its id.

```bash
nb-studio runtime delete <runtime>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `runtime` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                    |
| ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this runtime?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/agents/runners/{runnerId}` (`agentsDeleteRunner`)

## runtime list

List runners

Every runner for a reader of runners or of agents (`agents.runners` or `agents.agents` read); otherwise the caller's own.

```bash
nb-studio runtime list
```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `name`, `status`, `ownerName`, `trust`, `activeRuns`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runners` (`agentsListRunners`)

## runtime revoke

Revoke a runner

Revokes the runner and its keys; the runs and jobs it held go back to the queue. Its owner or a manager of runners (`agents.runners` manage); a manager revoking someone else's runner tells its owner.

```bash
nb-studio runtime revoke <runtime>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `runtime` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                                                                  |
| ------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Revoke this runtime? It stops taking work and must register again.” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/runners/{runnerId}/revoke` (`agentsRevokeRunner`)

## runtime runs

List a runner's recent runs

Its latest runs whatever their status, newest first, without the link of a private run the caller is not part of.

```bash
nb-studio runtime runs <runtime>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `runtime` |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `title`, `status`, `createdAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runners/{runnerId}/runs` (`agentsListRunnerRuns`)

## runtime token create

Create a runner registration token

A one-time token the install script registers a runner with; the token is shown only in this answer. Anyone signed in may add a personal runner; a runner shared with the team (`trust: team`) needs `agents.runners` manage.

```bash
nb-studio runtime token create
```

| Flag              | Type      | Description                                                                                                                                                          |
| ----------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--trust`         | team \\   | ownerOnly                                                                                                                                                            |             |
| `--enabled-tools` | claude \\ | codex \\                                                                                                                                                             | opencode \\ | pi  | (repeatable) |
| `--slots`         | integer   | How many runs at once the runner takes; omitted or null leaves it to the runner. A runner's own `--slots` overrides it.                                              |
| `--tool-slots`    | json      | How many runs of each coding tool the runner takes at once; omitted or null for no limits per tool. A runner's own limits per tool (`--slots claude=2`) override it. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agents/runners/registrationTokens` (`agentsCreateRunnerRegistrationToken`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio runtime token create --trust team
```

## runtime update

Update a runner

Its owner's alone, a manager of runners (`agents.runners` manage) included; a runner whose owner can no longer act (none recorded, or disabled or deleted) is changed by managers of runners.

```bash
nb-studio runtime update <runtime>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `runtime` |             |

| Flag              | Type      | Description                                                                                                               |
| ----------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--name`          | string    |                                                                                                                           |
| `--trust`         | team \\   | ownerOnly                                                                                                                 |             |
| `--slots`         | integer   |                                                                                                                           |
| `--tool-slots`    | json      | How many runs of each coding tool it may hold at once, beside `slots`; null, or a tool left out, for no limit of its own. |
| `--enabled-tools` | claude \\ | codex \\                                                                                                                  | opencode \\ | pi  | (repeatable) |
| `--accept-jobs`   | boolean   |                                                                                                                           |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/agents/runners/{runnerId}` (`agentsUpdateRunner`)

## runtime work

List the work a runner holds

Its runs as the caller may see them, then its jobs, while they are dispatched or running.

```bash
nb-studio runtime work <runtime>
```

| Argument  | Description |
| --------- | ----------- |
| `runtime` |             |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `kind`, `title`, `status`, `startedAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agents/runners/{runnerId}/work` (`agentsListRunnerWork`)
